stemMarkdown: The average of 18 observations was calculated as 37, but one observation was wrongly read as 25 instead of the correct value 51. What is the correct average? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: The recorded total was $18 \times 37 = 666$. Correcting the single entry changes it by $51 - 25 = 26$, giving a true total of $692$. The correct average is $\dfrac{692}{18} = 38.44$.
